name: Math O' Lantern: Counting Up Trail
domain: Subtraction by Counting Up to Benchmark Numbers
competency: Understanding subtraction as the distance between two numbers by hopping along benchmark tens and hundreds
ncertStandard: Grade 3 Mathematics: Chapter 6 - Fun with Give and Take (Mental Math)
overview: Children help the traveler hop along a glowing lantern trail starting from the smaller number (subtrahend) forward to the larger destination (minuend). By hopping to friendly tens and hundreds, children collect lantern distances whose sum equals the exact mathematical difference without column borrowing.
learningOutcomes: Understand subtraction as the forward distance between two numbers on a number line
Sum milestone jumps to discover the exact difference (e.g., 7 + 40 + 400 = 447)
Explore both structured Guided Journey and exploratory Sandbox modes
